summary: Time-of-day and weekday did not add a stable directional 4H reversal edge to the Daily S1/R1 + strong H1 rejection signal. None of nine preregistered Tokyo/London/New York Hour-1/2/3 comparisons survived Holm correction, global FWD4 phase heterogeneity was unsupported (p≈0.33), and weekday heterogeneity was unsupported (p≈0.55). Session phase strongly changed MFE/MAE path amplitude, indicating volatility/execution context rather than directional entry value.

robustness: Independent full-history reconstruction reproduced all 65,135 2022-2025 event keys, groups, distances, wick fractions, ATR values and forward/excursion fields exactly.
A deterministic 4H same-side/group cooldown reduced overlap but left phase omnibus p≈0.319 and weekday omnibus p≈0.836.
The 2022-2025 pooled Hour-3 improvement reverses in 2015-2019 and 2020-2021 and is therefore not a durable session law.
Tokyo H3 phase premium is positive across the three broad partitions but its combined interval crosses zero and matched controls show similar time behavior; it is not promoted.
limitations: All 2015-2025 data were already exposed in related pivot research; this is not a pristine holdout confirmation.
Structural midpoint entry/forward measurement is not executable BID/ASK P&L.
Repeated H1 signals are retained in the primary observational ledger; cooldown is robustness only.
Session phase materially changes volatility, so later execution research must predefine stop/target scaling rather than infer profitability from MFE alone.
No session×weekday interactions were tested after the main directional effects failed.
authorized_next: Treat session time as an execution/volatility context variable rather than a directional entry filter.
Design a separately preregistered execution study with explicit rearm/cooldown, executable BID/ASK entry, stop, target and holding rules.
Preserve Tokyo H3 only as a non-promoted observation for genuinely fresh data monitoring.
prohibited_next: Do not mine a fourth or fifth session hour, arbitrary clock windows, weekdays or session×weekday combinations on 2015-2025.
Do not select the best UTC hour from the descriptive 24-hour profile.
Do not represent MFE/MAE session differences as directional trading edge.
Do not treat this study as Pine, alert, sizing or live-trading authorization.
